DESIGN.md, hand-written by Alex, is the prose original of this spec

notes: Ink on college-rule paper. Exactly one hue exists on the site: the margin red (primary). Every status seed is therefore ink except danger, which is that same red; a green or amber has never appeared on this page and must not. Light only, on purpose: paper has no dark mode. The Arbiter's black page is a dark SURFACE inside the light theme, not a second mode. Three things the generic generator cannot express live in tokens/tokens.site.css: the 28px rule grid with its margin and gutter lanes, the hard zero-blur offset shadow that carries all elevation, and the 2.5px ink border. Those are hand-authored and authoritative.
